test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: What central idea does the passage convey about legality?

options.text: It is shaped by context and may be flawed

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. It is shaped by context and may be flawed**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage explains that **legality** is created by institutions and influenced by cultural, social, and historical context, which means laws can be imperfect or unjust at times. (यह संदर्भ से आकार लेता है और दोषपूर्ण हो सकता है) • **Example:** Civil disobedience movements arose because laws were unjust, showing that legality is not always morally correct. • **It is shaped by context and may be flawed** means laws change according to societal values and are sometimes imperfect. (यह संदर्भ से बनता है और कभी-कभी त्रुटिपूर्ण होता है) • **Example:** Practices once legal (like segregation) are now seen as morally wrong. • This highlights that legality is dynamic, not absolute, and must adapt to changing moral and social landscapes. Therefore, the correct answer is- It is shaped by context and may be flawed [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **It always reflects moral values** (यह हमेशा नैतिक मूल्यों को दर्शाता है): Means that laws are always aligned with morality. • **Example:** The passage shows this is not true, as some legal practices are later considered immoral. • **It is fixed and universal** (यह स्थिर और सार्वभौमिक है): Means laws never change and apply everywhere equally. • **Example:** The passage states legality is influenced by context, not fixed or universal. • **It ignores social change** (यह सामाजिक परिवर्तन की अनदेखी करता है): Means laws do not adapt to changing society. • **Example:** The mention of reform and technology shows that laws do respond to social and moral change. 3e:Tdc5, The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. To show moral challenges to unjust laws**.
